Becca Miller Rose.name: Becca Miller Rose
Becca Miller Rose.desc: Becca Rose is a seasoned healthcare operations leader, most recently serving as COO of the Optum Home-Based Medical Care business. Rose oversaw tremendous growth in the organization’s scalable national service capacity for senior populations.

Abhishri Aggarwal.name: Abhishri Aggarwal
Abhishri Aggarwal.desc: Abhishri has 10+ years of experience across program management, data analysis and leading new initiatives. She is passionate about innovation-driven sustainable growth and evidence-based decision making. Currently, she leads supply chain integration of sustainability and packaging initiatives for PepsiCo Beverages North America.

Abigail Barnes.name: Abigail Barnes
Abigail Barnes.desc: Abigail Barnes is a writer, founder, and lawyer. She created Amulet initially to promote a healthier and safer food system with rapid on-site electrochemical detection. The technology is now expanding to detect health metrics.

Adebayo (Sam) Alonge.name: Adebayo (Sam) Alonge
Adebayo (Sam) Alonge.desc: After surviving the usage of structural fake drug disbursement, Alonge co-created RxAll to mitigate the harm of counterfeit medical drugs. His work has deeply impacted the healthcare space in Africa, Asia, and North America, delivering certified quality medicines to more than 3 million patients per month.

Adrianna Alterman.name: Adrianna Alterman
Adrianna Alterman.desc: As one of Salesforce Ventures' first employees, Alterman leads investments in energy, climate tech, and workforce resilience technologies.

Alexandra Sing.name: Alexandra Sing
Alexandra Sing.org: Heron; Former Chief Operating Officer, Capitalize Good
Alexandra Sing.desc: Sing advises corporations on how to lead with enterprise capital in their businesses. She also manages a portfolio of investments aimed at empowering disadvantaged rural communities across the U.S.

Amy Kao.name: Amy Kao
Amy Kao.org: RxAll; Founder & Chairman, International Music & Arts Society
Amy Kao.desc: Kao works to increase access to medicine and reduce risk of counterfeit medicine usage.

Anastasia Mayr.name: Anastasia Mayr
Anastasia Mayr.role: Principal of Renewable Investments & Carbon Advisory
Anastasia Mayr.desc: Mayr works to build the green economy through the intersection of climate tech, policy, finance, and equity. She has more than 13 years of experience in the energy transition industry, covering efficiency, clean energy, and carbon mitigation sectors.

Andrea Levere.name: Andrea Levere
Andrea Levere.org: Capitalize Good; Social Enterprise Fellow, Yale SOM; Visiting Scholar, Federal Reserve Bank of New York; Ascend Fellow Alumni, Aspen Institute
Andrea Levere.desc: With a career spanning over three decades in economic development finance, asset-building, and financial inclusion, Levere has dedicated her professional life to addressing wealth inequality and creating pathways to economic opportunity.

Ann Olivarius.name: Ann Olivarius
Ann Olivarius.desc: Dr. Ann Olivarius is the Chair of McAllister Olivarius, a leading firm in the US and UK representing victims of sexual misconduct and discrimination in employment, universities, hospitals and other institutions.

Ariana Yuen.name: Ariana Yuen
Ariana Yuen.org: Forested - "we work with consumer brands and supply them with carbon-negative, nature-positive, and socially-just raw materials (honey, beeswax, essential and carrier oils, butters).
Ariana Yuen.desc: Ariana Yuen is a nature entrepreneur passionate about biodiversity, forest-grown ingredients, and systems thinking. She previously worked in management consulting, advising clients from across the commercial, government, and NGO/non-profit sectors.

Ashia Ajani.name: Ashia Ajani
Ashia Ajani.org: Sierra Club; Former Interim Executive Director, Youth vs Apocalypse
Ashia Ajani.desc: Ajani is an environmental justice storyteller, educator, and organizer. They work to highlight climate issues that Indigenous and low-income groups face, groups who are most affected by climate change and shoulder the most environmental burdens.

Ayush Acharya.name: Ayush Acharya
Ayush Acharya.desc: Ayush Acharya is an experienced energy consultant. He has worked on projects that promote climate mitigation and adaptation through clean energy in Nepal and now at PureSky in the U.S.

Beryl Ajwang.name: Beryl Ajwang
Beryl Ajwang.desc: Beryl Ajwang is passionate about driving sustainable development at the intersection of energy and food systems in Africa. She currently leads multi-country initiatives to reduce food loss and waste, and partners with governments, businesses, and NGOs to strengthen agricultural value chains and enhance farmer livelihoods.

Beth Brockland.name: Beth Brockland
Beth Brockland.org: Client Success & Business Development, Financial Health Network
Beth Brockland.desc: Former community organizer Beth Brockland works to support financial health for the Financial Health Network's members. She develops strategies that employers can use to improve their employees' financial health and benefits.

Billy Huang.name: Billy Huang
Billy Huang.org: Source Development Hub - early-stage evaluation organization, focused on developing resource delivery platforms for vulnerably housed individuals…"
Billy Huang.desc: Billy Huang is a biologist-turned-entrepreneur and social policy advocate with interests that lie at the intersection of economic development, workforce, housing, and public health. He is particularly interested in how to design and implement technology-based interventions to improve quality of life for marginalized communities.

Brandon Jones.name: Brandon Jones
Brandon Jones.desc: After retiring from being an Air Force officer and developing a deep sense of service, Brandon Jones directed his attention to consulting. At The Bridgespan Group, Jones advises nonprofits and foundations.

Brian Ambrette.name: Brian Ambrette
Brian Ambrette.desc: Brian Ambrette applies capacity building and leadership development to address complex issues including climate adaptation, community flood resilience and sea level rise preparedness, rural prosperity and resource conservation, and coastal management.

Bryan Fike.name: Bryan Fike
Bryan Fike.org: Nowak Metro Finance Lab, financing small businesses for inclusive economic growth
Bryan Fike.desc: At Nowak Metro Finance Lab, Fike focuses on financing for small businesses and inclusive economic growth. He is well-versed in economic development, public administration, and small business support.

Caitlin Chiquelin.name: Caitlin Chiquelin
Caitlin Chiquelin.desc: Caitlin Chiquelin is an experienced sustainability professional with a history of working in the environmental space. She is skilled in life cycle assessment, sustainability reporting, program development, and ESG risk analysis.

Cam Humphrey.name: Cam Humphrey
Cam Humphrey.org: NAACP Legal Defense and Education Fund; Articles Editor, Columbia Law Review; Former Philanthropy Fellow, Haas School of Business
Cam Humphrey.desc: Cam Humphrey has experience in agricultural policy and works at the intersection of law and the environment. He is currently a JD candidate at Columbia Law School, working to support Black grassroots organizations across the South fighting for environmental justice.

Caroline Ebinger.name: Caroline Ebinger
Caroline Ebinger.org: Lumi Partners; Former Venture Fellow, Transform Capital; Co-Founder, Mesa Foods
Caroline Ebinger.desc: Caroline Ebinger aims to combine her passion for nature and business to make a positive, tangible difference on the planet. She has experience in marketing & branding, operations, food/ag, and conservation.

Caroline Kronley.name: Caroline Kronley
Caroline Kronley.desc: Kronley is a philanthropy and non-profit leader with a track record in strategy development and execution for institutions and initiatives. She has extensive experience working across sectors, disciplines, and borders on a range of global and local issues.

Charlie Markowitz.name: Charlie Markowitz
Charlie Markowitz.role: Vice President of Energy Project Finance
Charlie Markowitz.desc: Markowitz has a background in energy economics, informing his decision-making related to energy transition policies and the financing structures that fund new projects. He currently specializes in non-recourse project finance transactions across the North American power sector.

Chloe Kidder.name: Chloe Kidder
Chloe Kidder.desc: As a skilled financial analyst and impact investing consultant, Kidder currently works at Arbor Rising, focused on engaging nonprofits in the pursuit of grant disbursement to nonprofits building pathways out of poverty.

Chris Larson.name: Chris Larson
Chris Larson.desc: Larson co-founded Alder Point Capital, a corporation working to acquire U.S. farmland and timberland in climate-resilient regions to drive income, appreciation, and impact across the climate, biodiversity, and water sectors.

Christine Bader.name: Christine Bader
Christine Bader.org: Linfield University School of Business; Author
Christine Bader.desc: For the last 20 years, Bader has developed expertise in corporate responsibility, helping big companies realize their impacts on the world and creating policies to mitigate the negatives and enhance the positives. She is a skilled communicator, with many articles written for news outlets, as well as a book titled, "The Evolution of a Corporate Idealist: When Girl Meets Oil."

Clint Bartlett.name: Clint Bartlett
Clint Bartlett.org: UNDP; Executive in Residence, Said School of Business at Oxford; Director, African Impact Ltd
Clint Bartlett.desc: Clint Bartlett's work sits at the intersection of multilateral development finance and private capital. He supports institutions like UNDP and UNCDF in identifying, structuring and mobilising investment into climate, food security, health and SME finance across the Global South.

Connie Chin.name: Connie Chin
Connie Chin.org: Global Arts Live; Skilled in nonprofit management and cultivation of the arts (dance, library, other curatorial pursuits)
Connie Chin.desc: Connie Chin is an experienced nonprofit executive with a history of building institutional capacity. She is skilled in nonprofit organizations, fundraising, entrepreneurship, museum exhibitions, special collections, dance, festivals, and event management.

Cortney Ahern Renton.name: Cortney Ahern Renton
Cortney Ahern Renton.org: Proofing Station; Former Executive Director of CitySeed, Inc.
Cortney Ahern Renton.desc: Cortney Renton is rooted in 15 years of multidisciplinary experience in leadership and strategy roles across diverse social impact organizations. Her primary focus is investing in integrated capital for food and agriculture enterprises.

Courtney Quinn.name: Courtney Quinn
Courtney Quinn.role: Senior Manager of Strategy & Operations at Ravel
Courtney Quinn.desc: Courtney Quinn is experience in issues at the intersection of big business, food, and sustainability. She achieves socially-focused agricultural solutions through marketing and strategy.

Darcy Schiber-Knowles.name: Darcy Schiber-Knowles
Darcy Schiber-Knowles.desc: Darcy Shiber-Knowles is an executive leader driving innovation at one of the world's most environmentally- and socially-oriented companies. She currently works on climate justice and circularity issues, which require interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaboration at the intersection of consumer products, technical operations, organizational change management, industry leadership and mission-driven impact.

David Browning.name: David Browning
David Browning.desc: Browning has decades of experience supporting smallholder farmers across Latin America and Africa. Currently, he is the CEO of Enveritas, a non-profit working to lift 5 million smallholder farmers out of poverty.

Deborah Spalding.name: Deborah Spalding
Deborah Spalding.desc: Deborah Spalding is the Global Head of Nature Finance for Conservation International where she oversees a team that mobilizes investment for nature. Previously, she served as Chief Investment Officer of Commonfund OCIO, an investment manager for endowments, foundations, and other nonprofit institutions.

DeNeile Cooper.name: DeNeile Cooper
DeNeile Cooper.role: Senior Manager of Strategic Engagement & Policy Implementation
DeNeile Cooper.desc: DeNeile Cooper is a sustainability strategist with a focus on waste management systems through the lens of waste infrastructure, supply chains, consumption culture, human systems and social history.

Denis Ring.name: Denis Ring
Denis Ring.org: OCHO Candy; Founder of Whole Foods 365 Brand; CEO, Bode International
Denis Ring.desc: Ring has extensive experience in developing organic, private-label brands for large grocers. He has since moved on to developing his own organic candy brand, OCHO Candy.

Donald Gips.name: Donald Gips
Donald Gips.org: Skoll Foundation; Board Member, Cassava Technologies; Senior Advisor, The Blackstone Group
Donald Gips.desc: Gips is recognized as a leader in social innovation and strategic philanthropy, drawing on extensive experience across public service, business, and diplomacy. He brings more than three decades of leadership across government, philanthropy, and the social sector.

Drew D'Alelio.name: Drew D'Alelio
Drew D'Alelio.desc: D'Alelio invests in category defining energy technology companies that align profit, purpose, and planet. Currently, he invests with Sabanci Climate Ventures' $200M corporate venture capital fund. We invest in early and growth stage companies that bring strategic value to Sabanci Holdings, Turkiye's leading energy generation and distribution utility company.

Ellen Abramowitz.name: Ellen Abramowitz
Ellen Abramowitz.desc: Abramowitz works at the intersection of sustainable energy systems and urban design. She has worked in sustainable finance and energy storage at many organizations, including Stem, Inc. and Wells Fargo.

Eric Rubenstein.name: Eric Rubenstein
Eric Rubenstein.desc: Eric Rubenstein is an investor with an enthusiastic focus on commodities, energy, and impact. Rubenstein has invested in dozens of companies both professionally (as a corporate strategic investor and as a venture fund manager) and on behalf of himself and his family’s alternative investment strategy.

Forest Abbott-Lum.name: Forest Abbott-Lum
Forest Abbott-Lum.role: Senior Staff Specialist of Climate Tech Finance
Forest Abbott-Lum.org: Bay Area Air District; Former Climate Action Planner, Rincon Consultants
Forest Abbott-Lum.desc: Abbott-Lum has extensive experience in the sustainable food systems and climate tech finance spaces. She is geared towards social justice, having organized communities around climate action.

Frances Klimczak.name: Frances Klimczak
Frances Klimczak.desc: Frances Klimczak is a leader in social entrepreneurship, female executive empowerment, and community development through public-private partnerships. She is the founder of Bridge Watch Consulting, a social-impact LLC focused on economic development and leadership consulting for non-profit and NGO executives.

Franz Hochstrasser.name: Franz Hochstrasser
Franz Hochstrasser.role: Managing Director of Finance at U.S. Green Bank
Franz Hochstrasser.desc: Franz Hochstrasser has worked at the nexus of climate, clean energy, community and capital for nearly twenty years. He is currently consulting, supporting governments, financial institutions, nonprofits and private companies to design and deploy capital solutions that scale clean energy and resilience.

George Gemelas.name: George Gemelas
George Gemelas.org: Indianapolis Business Journal; Co-Founder of The Axios Project, G2 Strategies, and Climate Solutions Fund
George Gemelas.desc: Gemelas works to help solve some of the core challenges on energy, climate, and society. He currently focuses on the global nuclear renaissance, cross-partisan support for energy and climate, Indiana's electricity grid, Greece and the environment, and the future of politics and society.

Grace McEnery.name: Grace McEnery
Grace McEnery.desc: Grace most recently served as an MBA Fellow at Potlikker Capital, a charitable loan fund that provides integrated, reparative capital to BIPOC farmers throughout the United States. Previously, she worked in development at Haley House, a food justice organization in Boston.

Hannah Adams.name: Hannah Adams
Hannah Adams.desc: Hannah Adams is experienced in nonprofit management with program and staff management roles in the U.S. and abroad. Focused on social impact roles in the U.S. connected to supporting social enterprises, enacting trust-based philanthropic strategies, and leading systems change approaches.

Hardik Pokhrel.name: Hardik Pokhrel
Hardik Pokhrel.desc: Hardik Pokhrel has extensive experience in renewable energy project development. He has worked for several companies with the goal of increasing energy access through clean energy technologies.

Hilary Pennington.name: Hilary Pennington
Hilary Pennington.role: Executive Vice President of Global Programs at Ford Foundation
Hilary Pennington.desc: A national expert on postsecondary education and intergenerational change, Pennington joined the Ford Foundation in 2013. Earlier, she was an independent consultant whose clients included the Next American University project of the New America Foundation and Arizona State University. She also led the Generations Initiative, a project funded by national foundations to develop effective responses to the dramatic demographic shifts occurring in the United States.

Jahi Wise.name: Jahi Wise
Jahi Wise.org: Southern Communities Initiative; Former Special Assistant to the President, Climate Policy and Finance
Jahi Wise.desc: Wise came to energy and infrastructure through community organizing. Early in his career, he led a campaign to direct funding for a major stormwater project into low-impact development projects like rain gardens, bioswales, and neighborhood-scale green infrastructure. Currently, he is the ED of Southern Communities Initiative, aiming to driv economic growth in historically underinvested areas.

James Robertson.name: James Robertson
James Robertson.org: Provincetown Art Association and Museum; Independent consultant; former Chief Executive, India HIV/AIDS Alliance
James Robertson.desc: Robertson has had a long, global career advocating for people living with HIV and for LGBTQ+ communities. Talking with students, he encouraged those who are committed to making a meaningful societal impact to develop the leadership skills they’ll need to drive change.

Jeff Adams.name: Jeff Adams
Jeff Adams.desc: Adams is a digital technology and marketing executive with 19+ years of experience implementing customer engagement strategies and solutions that benefit clients, their customers and the world we live in. He works with energy users and utilities to drive behavioral changes.

Jeff Grosz.name: Jeff Grosz
Jeff Grosz.org: Evidence Action - leads the Accelerator focused on Safe Water and Maternal, Neonatal, and Child Health program pillars
Jeff Grosz.desc: Grosz works to build the next generation of cost-effective programs that are ready for scaling, with a focus on safe water and neonatal and child healthcare. Previously, he worked to increase access to quality cancer treatment in Uganda.

Jessamine Fitzpatrick.name: Jessamine Fitzpatrick
Jessamine Fitzpatrick.desc: Shadle co-founded Alder Point Capital, a corporation working to acquire U.S. farmland and timberland in climate-resilient regions to drive income, appreciation, and impact across the climate, biodiversity, and water sectors.

Jinali Mody.name: Jinali Mody
Jinali Mody.desc: Jinali Mody is the founder and CEO of Banofi Leather. Her company is reducing the environmental impacts from fashion with plant-based leather made from crop waste. She previously worked as a Business Analyst at McKinsey & Co.

Joe Dobrow.name: Joe Dobrow
Joe Dobrow.org: focused on connecting business education with food business and sustainability-focused sectors
Joe Dobrow.desc: Joe Dobrow is a writer and marketing consultant who is the author of the new entrepreneurial history of the natural foods industry. He has more than two decades of experience as the top marketing executive for some of the most prominent natural foods retailers in the U.S., including Whole Foods, Fresh Fields and Sprouts.

Judy Samuelson.name: Judy Samuelson
Judy Samuelson.role: Executive Director of Aspen Business & Society Program; VP of Aspen Institute
Judy Samuelson.desc: Judy Samuelson is founder and executive director of the Aspen Institute Business and Society Program and author of Six New Rules of Business: Creating Real Value in a Changing World. She has worked in legislative affairs in CA, as a banker in New York's garment center, and ran the impact investing arm of the Ford Foundation.

Julienne Oyler.name: Julienne Oyler
Julienne Oyler.desc: Julienne Oyler, is the founder and executive director of African Entrepreneur Collective (AEC). Julienne is passionate about developing the capacity of African youth, which led her to found AEC to help young entrepreneurs grow their businesses and create jobs for others, stemming the epidemic of youth unemployment across Africa.

Katherine Gross.name: Katherine Gross
Katherine Gross.desc: Katherine Gross is the Director of The Charlotte Foundation, a family foundation that provides high-performing nonprofits with strategic advice along with funding. She also works to improve the efficacy of Boston area philanthropy by serving on the Boards of the Social Innovation Forum and Edvestors.

Kelly McGlinchey.name: Kelly McGlinchey
Kelly McGlinchey.role: Principal at Quantis; Adjunct Professor of Ecological Agriculture
Kelly McGlinchey.org: Connecticut College; Founder & President, Table & Tith
Kelly McGlinchey.desc: Kelly is a passionate, results-oriented leader in the food sustainability sector who finds her work most fulfilling when building partnerships, facilitating community engagement, and connecting stakeholders to execute a vision.

Linda Mason.name: Linda Mason
Linda Mason.org: Bright Horizons; Board Chair, Mercy Corps
Linda Mason.desc: In her formative years, Linda Mason observed international war and invasions and began a path down humanitarian work. She brought this work back to her in the US, noticing a childcare crisis and creating the nation's largest childcare company, serving over 150,000 families.

Lindsay Greene.name: Lindsay Greene
Lindsay Greene.org: Brooklyn Navy Yard Development Corporation - stewarding a former shipyard that now houses more than 550 businesses
Lindsay Greene.desc: Lindsay Greene is devoted to building an economy that uplifts BIPOC and businesses that help solve real problems. With previous experience at Goldman Sachs, Fresh Direct, and more, she returned to her urban development roots and oversees the inclusive prosperity of Brooklyn's Navy Yard.

Lindsey Brace-Martinez.name: Lindsey Brace-Martinez
Lindsey Brace-Martinez.desc: Lindsey Martinez provides best-in-class governance, strategy and execution skill to institutions that want to scale long-term, financially competitive and sustainable solutions in the capital markets.

Liz Berry Gips.name: Liz Berry Gips
Liz Berry Gips.org: Draper Richards Kaplan Foundation; Board Chair, School of Leadership, Afghanistan
Liz Berry Gips.desc: Liz Berry Gips has three decades of experience in education and leadership development. She has served as a leader, entrepreneur and strategist for a variety of organizations in the non-profit, academic and public sectors. She is especially skilled at developing innovative organizations and strategic partnerships and at managing Boards and teams.

Louise Dubé.name: Louise Dubé
Louise Dubé.desc: Inspired by a deep commitment to creating pathways to lives of learning and purpose, she has devoted her career to ensuring that all students are prepared for civic life. Louise has successfully led K-12 growth organizations that use educational media to improve student achievement across the private and nonprofit sectors.

Lucy Kessler.name: Lucy Kessler
Lucy Kessler.desc: Lucy is a leading expert in sustainable finance with nearly fifteen years of experience advancing climate solutions, spanning industry, energy, finance, and advocacy, and has successfully built ambitious climate action initiatives across complex stakeholder groups.

Margaret Tallmadge.name: Margaret Tallmadge
Margaret Tallmadge.org: Colusa Indian Energy; former Director of Development, Navajo Power
Margaret Tallmadge.desc: Tallmadge's impact is focused on a long-term goal to address the dearth of capital available to tribes for clean energy infrastructure.

Margaret Williams.name: Margaret Williams
Margaret Williams.org: Arctic Initiative; Former Managing Director of Arctic Programs, World Wildlife Fund
Margaret Williams.desc: Williams has worked for over 25 years on conservation issues in Russia and Alaska. Prior to joining the Arctic Initiative, Williams worked to establish a biodiversity conservation program in marine and coastal ecosystems in the U.S., Russia, and Canada.

Marian Chertow.name: Marian Chertow
Marian Chertow.org: Yale University; Director, Yale Center for Industrial Ecology
Marian Chertow.desc: Dr. Chertow’s research and teaching focus on industrial ecology, business/environment issues, circular economy and waste management. She is best known for championing the study of industrial symbiosis involving geographically-based exchanges of materials, energy, water and by-products within networks of businesses globally.

Martine Singer.name: Martine Singer
Martine Singer.desc: Martine Singer is the President and CEO of Children’s Institute, a social impact organization that works in communities impacted by decades of racism and underinvestment.

Mary Ellen Iskenderian.name: Mary Ellen Iskenderian
Mary Ellen Iskenderian.desc: Mary Ellen is a passionate advocate for women’s economic empowerment through greater access to finance and is a leading voice for women’s leadership in financial services. She has spoken widely and published extensively on the topic of equality of economic opportunity and women’s financial inclusion.

Matt Kopac.name: Matt Kopac
Matt Kopac.org: Pure Strategies, Inc. Previously worked as a Sustainability Director at Burt's Bee's and an Eisenhower Circular Economy Fellow
Matt Kopac.desc: Matt Kopac is a purpose-driven sustainability and social impact leader with significant experience in strategy, product innovation, operations, supply chain, and community impact. He is a community-rooted change-agent dedicated to a sustainable and equitable future.

Meaghan McGrath.name: Meaghan McGrath
Meaghan McGrath.desc: Meaghan is Director of Food Tech for 9 North Group, a firm that specializes in scaling innovations in food and agriculture. She has worked for companies advancing innovative business models to scale more sustainable food production. Across her roles, Meaghan focuses on strategy, partnerships and product development.

Meg Byerly Williams.name: Meg Byerly Williams
Meg Byerly Williams.org: Skeo Group; Former Staff Attorney & Consultant at Elisabeth Haub School of Law
Meg Byerly Williams.desc: Meg has 16 years of experience practicing as an attorney and policy leader in land use, regulatory compliance, and sustainable development. Her career has focused on translating complex legal and policy frameworks into practical, implementable strategies that help governments and mission-driven organizations achieve policy, regulatory, and compliance goals.

Michael Apkon.name: Michael Apkon
Michael Apkon.org: Coverys Insurance; Former CEO, Tufts Medical Center & Floating Hospital for Children
Michael Apkon.desc: Dr. Apkon is a physician executive and physician scientist serving in C-level leadership roles at several top academic hospitals in the United States and Canada as well as an advisor to healthcare and life-sciences companies.

Nancy Pfund.name: Nancy Pfund
Nancy Pfund.desc: Nancy Pfund is a pioneer and leading player in impact investing. As the Founder of DBL, she has helped to reveal the power of venture capital to promote social change and environmental improvement. Pfund currently sits on the board of 9 companies and often engages academic and professional audiences in the importance of impact investing.

Nathaniel Heller.name: Nathaniel Heller
Nathaniel Heller.desc: Heller has spent 25 years building new things in challenging places, from distributed solar fintech, device financing, and last-mile distribution networks. Most of this work was executed in markets where the infrastructure and sometimes the product category had to be invented from scratch.

Nenha Young.name: Nenha Young
Nenha Young.org: Coalition for Green Capital; Former Analyst at McKinsey & Company
Nenha Young.desc: At CGC, Young supports the expansion of CGC’s efforts to raise and deploy climate finance programs, products, and services in low-income and disadvantaged communities across the United States.

Nikola Alexandre.name: Nikola Alexandre
Nikola Alexandre.org: Conservation International; Co-Founder of Shelterwood Collective
Nikola Alexandre.desc: Alexandre leads a global team dedicated to increasing the flow of financing to high-quality nature-based solution projects around the world. He is also the co-founder, Stewardship Lead, and Board Treasurer of the Shelterwood Collective, a land justice and forest restoration nonprofit that focuses on demonstrating community-centered approaches to land stewardship.

Omar Ben Halim.name: Omar Ben Halim
Omar Ben Halim.role: Head of MENA (Middle East and North Africa)
Omar Ben Halim.desc: Omar Ben Halim has experience investing in and promoting policy solutions for a range of enviornmental issues, including climate, water, clean energy, critical minerals, supply chains, and agriculture.

Pari Kasotia.name: Pari Kasotia
Pari Kasotia.role: Head of State and Federal Policy/Regulatory Affairs
Pari Kasotia.desc: Pari is an energy policy expert with 10+ years of experience in the clean energy space. She works to bridge the gap between energy policy and on-the-ground project implementation.

Peter Waggonner.name: Peter Waggonner
Peter Waggonner.desc: Peter Waggonner has a special interest in the insurability and financeability of communities. As VP of Policy & Sustainability for Greater New Orleans, Inc., Southeast Louisiana’s regional economic development organization, Peter's portfolio encompasses infrastructure, insurance, and the environment at local, state, and federal levels.

Rachel Gould.name: Rachel Gould
Rachel Gould.org: US DOE; Senior Investments Associate, HASI
Rachel Gould.desc: Rachel Gould is an environmental professional passionate about addressing climate change and reversing nature loss through capital investments. She has experience ranging across many aspects of the environmental field including sustainable investing, climate tech, consulting, corporate sustainability, and nonprofits.

Ravneeta Consul.name: Ravneeta Consul
Ravneeta Consul.desc: Through her work, Consul has developed a deeper understanding of the structural nature of medical debt in the United States. She has extensive experience in strategy and operations, as well as M&A, growth, and innovation projects.

Rita Effah.name: Rita Effah
Rita Effah.desc: Rita Effah is a Senior Climate Finance Officer at the African Development Bank (AfDB). She is the Coordinator of the Africa Climate Change Fund, a multi-donor trust fund hosted by the AfDB to improve the resilience of African countries to the negative impacts of climate change and the transition to sustainable low-carbon development.

Rob Levy.name: Rob Levy
Rob Levy.org: Capital One; Former VP of Research, Financial Health Network
Rob Levy.desc: Levy has developed his career by helping financial services companies design solutions to improve the financial health of their customers, clients, and employees. He primarily leads expert teams to enable strategic, data-driven decisions.

Seth Goldman.name: Seth Goldman
Seth Goldman.role: Co-founder & CEO at Just Ice Tea
Seth Goldman.org: Co-Found & Board Chair at PLNT Burger, Chair of Board at Beyond Meat
Seth Goldman.desc: Goldman has extensive experience in the sustainable agriculture business, having launched several businesses. With each experience, he shares a commitment to organic and fair trade products, believing that they help provide a more just, healthier way of life for farmers and the planet.

Simon Bunyan.name: Simon Bunyan
Simon Bunyan.role: Management and Program Analyst in the Office of Energy Justice & Equity; US DOE
Simon Bunyan.desc: Simon Bunyan has extensive experience with government agencies, working to help communities implement clean energy solutions.

Sooah Rho.name: Sooah Rho
Sooah Rho.desc: Sooah Rho brings a wealth of experience in social impact consulting, advocacy, and education. Previously, she worked at Social Finance, assisting the impact advisory and investments team to drive change in workforce development and education.

Spenser Shadle.name: Spenser Shadle
Spenser Shadle.desc: Shadle co-founded Alder Point Capital, a corporation working to acquire U.S. farmland and timberland in climate-resilient regions to drive income, appreciation, and impact across the climate, biodiversity, and water sectors.

Srishti Singh.name: Srishti Singh
Srishti Singh.desc: Srishti focuses her work on water and climate finance, with the goal of bringing more finance into the water sector of the Global South. Singh helps tackle issues of climate resilience and water security.

Stephen Nabinger.name: Stephen Nabinger
Stephen Nabinger.role: Senior Manager of Global Health Advocacy and Communications
Stephen Nabinger.desc: Nabinger is a health strategist who manages a portfolio to promote global health equality, with a focus on maternal, newborn, child health, and family planning.

Sue AnderBois.name: Sue AnderBois
Sue AnderBois.org: Chair of Special Committee on Environment and Resiliency, Providence City Council
Sue AnderBois.desc: Before devoting her time exclusively to the Providence City Council, Sue Anderbois worked at The Nature Conservancy on climate and clean energy policy solutions at the state and regional level, as well as helping municipalities plan for climate resilience. She has also served as Rhode Island’s first director of food policy, working to support local farmers, fishers, and makers.

Svetlana Gabrilyan.name: Svetlana Gabrilyan
Svetlana Gabrilyan.org: EDF Renewables; Clean Energy Leadership Institute Fellow
Svetlana Gabrilyan.desc: Gabrilyan leads the development of utility scale solar projects across several states in the Midwest, while managing relationships with government officials and stakeholders.

Terry Baker.name: Terry Baker
Terry Baker.desc: Terry Baker oversees all of SAF’s programs and collaborates with key stakeholders to establish a strategic vision committed to the scientific sustainable management of America’s forests.

Tess Hart.name: Tess Hart
Tess Hart.desc: Tess Hart focuses on how social enterprise can catalyze economic and environmental progress in US cities. She is co-founder of Triple Bottom Brewing Company, a community craft brewery and social enterprise that creates jobs for people who face barriers to employment and connects small farmers to the growing craft beer industry.

Tony Cisneros.name: Tony Cisneros
Tony Cisneros.org: Deloitte; Former Program Director for The Garrison Institute's Pathways to Planetary Health; Co-Founder of Mesa Foods
Tony Cisneros.desc: Tony Cisneros is a Manager in Deloitte's Sustainability Strategy & Transformation practice. He focuses primarily on food systems and nature-based solutions intersecting core business operations and sustainability.

Trent Fuenmayor.name: Trent Fuenmayor
Trent Fuenmayor.org: Bureau of African Affairs, US State Department
Trent Fuenmayor.desc: Fuenmayor has 10+ years of global experience driving impact across policy, technology, and non-profits. At the U.S. Department of State, he leads a bureau-wide data strategy and responsible AI deployment in African embassies. His background includes launching Coinbase’s $400M+ Giving program, managing partnerships in refugee and public health initiatives, and scaling operations in conflict-affected regions.

Viveca Morris.name: Viveca Morris
Viveca Morris.org: Environment & Animals Program) - Yale Law School
Viveca Morris.desc: Morris investigates the impacts of big business on the environment. Her recent research focuses on the role of multinational agribusinesses in the climate crisis, strategies to hold agribusinesses and associated actors accountable for their environmental impacts and externalized costs, and policy reforms needed to make agriculture more sustainable, humane, and resilient.

Zoë Geller.name: Zoë Geller
Zoë Geller.org: Fire Ox Foods - "making food that is better for people and the planet by making vegetable-based foods accessible to all"
Zoë Geller.desc: Zoë Geller is passionate about helping people eat well and supporting others in building mission-driven brands that create a more compassionate, sustainable world. At her startup, Fire Ox Foods, she has developed and commercialized 5 frozen meal products.

Dan Weiss.name: Dan Weiss
Dan Weiss.org: Metropolitan Museum of Art; Emeritus Faculty, Johns Hopkins Krieger School of Arts & Sciences
Dan Weiss.desc: Daniel Weiss is an incredibly decorated leader and scholar. In his academic and professional life, has a deep focus on art history and museum/non-profit management, spanning the Middle Ages through Late Antiquity. He is the recipient of three honorary degrees and awards including the Yale SOM Business and Society Award and the Van Courtlandt Elliott Award from the Medieval Academy of America.

Jessica Labbe.name: Jessica Labbe
Jessica Labbe.desc: Jessica Labbe has devoted her career to the arts. Prior to her tenure at the Yale Center for British Art and the University Art Gallery, she worked as an Associate at a private art gallery in New York. She now manages the Center's finances and business operations.

Michael Barker.name: Michael Barker
Michael Barker.org: Pursued by a Bear LLC; CFO, The 5th Avenue Theatre; Fundraising Consultant, Wesport Museum for History and Culture
Michael Barker.desc: Michael Barker is a skilled nonprofit manager and leader in the arts. Equipped with an MBA and an MFA from Yale, he has led large teams across theatres, consultancies, and his own nonprofit. He is an artist through and through, and a talented financial advisor and management specialist.

Tiffany Lau.name: Tiffany Lau
Tiffany Lau.desc: Tiffany Lau work at the intersection of philanthropy, social justice, and community power, supporting the people and nonprofits building structural change from the ground up. She aligns values, vision, strategy, and implementation across grantmaking strategy, capacity building programs, and community relationships. She applies her deep skillset in management to the arts.

Ramesh Ramanathan.name: Ramesh Ramanathan
Ramesh Ramanathan.desc: Ramesh Ramanathan is a banker-turned-social entrepreneur. Together with his wife, Swati Ramanathan, they push for local governance mechanisms and self-determination in Indian cities, from affordable housing to micro-financing.

Joseph Bronner.name: Joseph Bronner
Joseph Bronner.desc: Joseph has the mind of an inventor & the heart of a connector. If you work with him, you’ll quickly find out he is primarily motivated by the prospect of finding hidden threads that enable him to make maximal positive impact wherever he is.
